severity_selection_basis: Three valid medium runs produced a repeatable mean increase of 99.649 mCPU with 4.947% CV and null SLO manifestation; high raises only requested CPU demand to 150 mCPU while preserving other conditions and retaining headroom below the 200 mCPU limit.
limitations: The first high run is a calibration and may still produce null manifestation.
The 200 mCPU container limit may cause substantial throttling; throttling is reported but is not itself an SLO manifestation.
The profile changes requested severity only; target, workload, seed, SLO, coverage and lifecycle durations remain fixed.
This profile does not authorize post-hoc thresholds, a different workload, a different service or model training.
